failure_modes.cause: Vapour pressure of acetonitrile exceeds pump inlet pressure at T > 50°C
failure_modes.mitigation: Pressurise feed reservoir to 0.5 bar above vapour pressure

failure_modes.cause: Particulate matter or crystallization in the BPR valve
failure_modes.mitigation: Install inline filter before BPR and ensure regular maintenance
Implement temperature monitoring and automatic shutdown system

single_points_of_failure: BPR valve — blockage stops all flow
validation_experiments: Run blank solvent at Q=0.05522 mL/min for 60 min; monitor pressure for drift > 5%
Conduct thermal stability test at 50°C with real-time temperature monitoring
Perform particle size analysis on feed to ensure no particulates > 10 microns
